title: Tick-tock Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 tbsp peeled and finely chopped fresh root ginger
steps: Put ginger, garlic, spices, salt, chicken, passata and coconut milk into slow cooker bowl.
Cook on high for 4 hours, or on low for 8 hours. Uncover; cool 10 minutes.
Mix yogurt and cornflour in a small bowl; leave 5 minutes.
Spoon yogurt mixture on top of curry; leave a couple of minutes to warm through.
Stir yogurt mixture into curry; replace lid; leave 15 minutes to thicken.
Adjust seasoning; remove cardamom pods if found. Serve sprinkled with nigella seeds.
notes: Serve with basmati rice and sides such as Jeera Aloo (p.172) or 5-Minute Saag Dhal (p.174).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
